stations.title: Rosa
stations.note: The log says all saved. CPC-31.

captions: Last, Rosa reports that three Sunday bookings never reached the online system.
The sync says it saved all three in the same second, and no error is ever logged.
You catch the early finish, fix the sync and write the test, in three tasks.
Now the sync is done only when every save is, and a failed save is reported.
Same three bookings. The log tells the truth, and the dock knows them all.
